name: Greenlight Capital Re (GLRE)
teaser: At 0.73 times book, GLRE looks cheap until you price the return: today's quote already pays for a 9.3% return on equity, and 9.0% is what the business earns through a cycle.
llms: Cayman-based specialty property and casualty reinsurer whose invested assets sit mostly in Solasglas, a fund managed by a related party. Valued on justified price to book from a 9.0% sustainable return on equity against a 12% cost of equity, cross-checked with a normalized earnings bridge at 9x. Bear $6.78, Base $15.09, Bull $27.52. Verdict Hold at $14.97, maximum buy price $8.30.
